_comment: Byte-for-byte copies of FamCart modules. Vendored rather than imported because
this repo is a submodule and must also work as a standalone clone, where
sha256 is authoritative: test/vendorDrift.test.ts checks it from here, and
FamCart's own test/vendorDrift.test.js checks it from the other side, so an
edit to either copy fails a test wherever it is made. Never edit these files
directly -- change the upstream module and re-copy, then update the hash.
The hash is of the LF-NORMALIZED bytes. FamCart is developed on Windows with
core.autocrlf=true, so the working copy is CRLF there and LF on a Linux CI
runner; hashing the raw file would make this test pass on one and fail on the
other. Both drift tests strip CR before comparing, so the check survives the
crossing without going blind to a real edit.
Refresh with, from the FamCart root:

productSearch.ts.why: normalizeSearchText and productKey decide which candidate rows collapse together before load. A divergent copy would collapse a different set than the database does.

productEmoji.ts.why: getProductEmoji makes the coverage report exact rather than an approximation of the app's keyword table.
